info.name: SKYO · Train API (RailCore)
info.description:
Two folders:

1. **SKYO backend** — `/api/train/*` on your Next.js app (validated, rate-limited, credit-guarded). Use this from the website / future mobile app.
2. **RailCore direct** — every RailCore v1 endpoint, for debugging only. Set `railcore_key` in a Postman *environment* (never commit it).

⚠️ Free plan = 2,500 credits/month, 20 req/min, 300 req/day. The credit cost is in every request name. Failed (4xx/5xx) calls are free.

Login-required SKYO endpoints: run `0 · Auth` first (Postman stores the cookie). POST requests need header `X-Requested-With: skyo`.
